d:
Watch the official song video of "Kisa Paathiyil" from 'Kismath', a Malayalam movie starring Shane Nigam, Shruthy Menon, Vinay Forrt, P. Balachandran, Sunil Sukhada, Alencier Ley, Sajitha Madathil among others. Written and directed by Shanavas K. Bavakutty. Produced by Shailaja Manikandan under the banner of Pattam Cinema Company in association with Collective Phase One. Muzik247 is the official music label.
Song: Kisa Paathiyil
Singer: Sachin Balu
Backing Vocals: Suchith Suresan & Sushin Shyam
Lyrics: Anwar Ali
Music: Sushin Shyam
Tabala/Dolak: Ramakrishnan
Flute: Vishnu Vijay
